title: Prove the cap-writes / door-reads seam end to end
action: The semantic judge returned NEEDS_REVISION on wc-2 with this failure signature: the cross-cell contract trace.proof = "unrecorded" is WRITTEN by capCell (packages/bee/lib/cells.mjs:2239) and READ by both door predicates (packages/bee/lib/state.mjs:2527 and :2592), but no test exercises both sides in one run. Every door row is seeded by writeUnrecordedCappedCell (test_bee_cli.mjs:2046), which hand-writes the field. A rename or shape drift on either side leaves both suites green. Close that seam: add at least one integration case that drives a real cap through capCell with neither verify output nor verification_evidence, then hits a real feature-debt door (the compounding close door and the start-feature door are the two cheapest) and asserts the refusal names that cell. Do NOT hand-write trace.proof anywhere in the new case — the whole point is that capCell produces the value the door consumes. Add the mirror row too: a cap that DID record real verify output must let the same door open, so the case cannot pass vacuously. Keep the existing hand-written fixture rows; they cover the door x kind matrix cheaply and this cell adds the producer-consumer proof beside them, it does not replace them. Test-only cell: do not touch the lib directory. This cell owns its regen chain — run the plugin skill-tree render, then the onboarding apply, then the release-manifest write, in that order, before capping.

truths: At least one test drives capCell with no output and no evidence and then asserts a real door refuses, naming that cell
The new case never writes trace.proof by hand
A mirror case with real recorded verify output lets the same door open, so the assertion cannot pass vacuously
The existing hand-written door x kind matrix rows stay green

artifacts.substantive: producer-consumer integration case: capCell to a real door, plus its opening mirror; no writeUnrecordedCappedCell in the new rows

key_links: the new case imports and calls capCell from the cells lib rather than seeding a cell file
prohibitions: No change to the cells or state lib modules
Do not delete or weaken the existing hand-written fixture rows
Do not hand-write trace.proof in the new case

trace.dropped_reason: Folded into wc-2: the NEEDS_REVISION verdict reopened wc-2, so the seam repair belongs in that cell rather than a dependent one that can never become ready.
